headline: Blue Jackets’ Sean Monahan leaves game with upper-body injury
take: Daily Faceoff reports Sean Monahan left Columbus's game with an upper-body injury, and it lands on a player whose season hasn't found its footing. Monahan has one goal on 3.55 expected goals (the quality of his chances) through 17 games, 2.55 below what those chances usually return, and seven points while playing about 16 minutes a night. Last season he had 36 points in 78 games. The Blue Jackets are 7-10-0 and have had 46% of the expected goals, so they have little cushion for losing a center who also sits on the power play (three power-play points). His five-on-five numbers have been soft (43% of expected goals with him on the ice), but a thin lineup feels any absence. No timeline has been reported.
